verses.1: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
verses.2: “Now you, son of man, take up a lament for Tyre.
verses.3:
Tell Tyre, who dwells at the gateway to the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coasts, that this is what the Lord GOD says:
 You have said, O Tyre,
 ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
verses.4:
Your borders are in the heart of the seas;
 your builders perfected your beauty.
verses.5:
They constructed all your planking
 with cypress + 27:5 Or pine or juniper or fir from Senir. + 27:5 That is, Mount Hermon 
 They took a cedar from Lebanon
 to make a mast for you.
verses.6:
Of oaks from Bashan
 they made your oars;
 of wood from the coasts of Cyprus + 27:6 Hebrew Kittim 
 they made your deck, inlaid with ivory.
verses.7:
Of embroidered fine linen from Egypt
 they made your sail,
 which served as your banner.
 Of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah
 they made your awning.
verses.8:
The men of Sidon and Arvad
 were your oarsmen.
 Your men of skill, O Tyre,
 were there as your captains.
verses.9:
The elders of Gebal were aboard as shipwrights,
 repairing your leaks.
 All the ships of the sea and their sailors
 came alongside to barter for your merchandise.
verses.10:
Men of Persia, Lydia, and Put
 served as warriors in your army.
 They hung their shields and helmets on your walls;
 they gave you splendor.
verses.11:
Men of Arvad and Helech
 manned your walls all around,
 and the men of Gammad
 were in your towers.
 They hung their shields around your walls;
 they perfected your beauty.
verses.12: Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for your wares.
verses.13: Javan, + 27:13 That is, Greece Tubal, and Meshech were your merchants. They exchanged slaves and bronze utensils for your merchandise.
verses.14: The men of Beth-togarmah exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.
verses.15: The men of Dedan + 27:15 Hebrew; LXX Rhodes were your clients; many coastlands were your market; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
verses.16: Aram + 27:16 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew manuscripts and Syriac Edom was your customer because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies for your wares.
verses.17: Judah and the land of Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith, cakes and honey, oil and balm for your merchandise.
verses.18: Because of your many products and your great wealth of goods, Damascus traded with you wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar,
verses.19: and casks of wine from Izal for your wares. + 27:19 Probable reading; MT —and Dan and Javan from Uzal (traded) for your wares Wrought iron, cassia, and sweet cane + 27:19 Or calamus were exchanged for your merchandise. + 27:19 Or were among your merchandise
verses.20: Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.
verses.21: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers, trading in lambs, rams, and goats.
verses.22: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your wares they exchanged gold, the finest of all spices, and precious stones.
verses.23: Haran, Canneh, and Eden traded with you, and so did the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad.
verses.24: In your marketplace they traded with you fine garments of blue, embroidered work, and multicolored rugs with cords tightly twisted and knotted.
verses.25:
The ships of Tarshish + 27:25 Or A fleet of trading ships 
 carried your merchandise.
 And you were filled with heavy cargo
 in the heart of the sea.
verses.26:
Your oarsmen have brought you
 onto the high seas,
 but the east wind will shatter you
 in the heart of the sea.
verses.27:
Your wealth, wares, and merchandise,
 your sailors, captains, and shipwrights,
 your merchants and all the warriors within you,
 with all the other people on board,
 will sink into the heart of the sea
 on the day of your downfall.
verses.28:
The countryside will shake
 when your sailors cry out.
verses.29:
All who handle the oars
 will abandon their ships.
 The sailors and all the captains of the sea
 will stand on the shore.
verses.30:
They will raise their voices for you
 and cry out bitterly.
 They will throw dust on their heads
 and roll in ashes.
verses.31:
They will shave their heads for you
 and wrap themselves in sackcloth.
 They will weep over you
 with anguish of soul and bitter mourning.
verses.32:
As they wail and mourn over you,
 they will take up a lament for you:
 ‘Who was ever like Tyre,
 silenced in the middle of the sea?
verses.33:
When your wares went out to sea,
 you satisfied many nations.
 You enriched the kings of the earth
 with your abundant wealth and merchandise.
verses.34:
Now you are shattered by the seas
 in the depths of the waters;
 your merchandise and the people among you
 have gone down with you.
verses.35:
All the people of the coastlands
 are appalled over you.
 Their kings shudder with fear;
 their faces are contorted.
verses.36:
Those who trade among the nations
 hiss at you;
 you have come to a horrible end
 and will be no more.’”
